title: The Crab Derby, 2016
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Thirty-second annual. Gully's girl, six, draws the crab this year. Wood letters it. He's demoted and he's never been happier.

panels.composition: Gully's. The counter. GULLY's GIRL, six, standing on a crate, a marker, a flyer. WOOD beside her with a pen. GULLY holding the twenty. BARNABY II underfoot.

characters.pose: on a crate with a marker

balloons.text: Thirty-two. She draws the crab. You letter.
I've drawn that crab eighteen times.

image.prompt: a six-year-old girl standing on a crate at a shop counter drawing on a flyer with a marker, a thin man beside her holding a pen, a stocky man holding out a twenty-dollar bill, a three-legged dog underfoot, clean ink

panels.composition: The girl's crab. Enormous. Twelve legs. Smiling. Wood looking at it with the face of a man watching a tradition end and something better start.

image.prompt: close-up of a child's marker drawing of a huge smiling crab with too many legs, a man looking at it with a complicated tender face

panels.composition: Wood lettering under it, in the strip's display face: 32ND ANNUAL CRAB DERBY. And, smaller, in her honor: A COLLABORATION.

image.prompt: a man carefully hand-lettering beneath a child's crab drawing on a flyer
image.notes: A COLLABORATION — the 2005 scribble, honored. Letter after.

panels.composition: Nineteen flyers on the wall. The nineteenth has twelve legs. Gully hands the twenty to his daughter. She hands it to Wood. Wood hands it back to her. The dog eats a maple bar.

image.prompt: nineteen crab flyers in a row on a shingle wall, a child and a thin man passing a twenty-dollar bill back and forth, a stocky man watching, a three-legged dog eating a pastry, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: The girl draws the crab. Wood letters. The twenty goes around in a circle.
